s1.syndrome_frame: a growing, painless breast nodule with calcifications
salient_findings: growing, painless nodule in the lower outer quadrant of the left breast
firm, mobile, well-defined lesion without skin changes
well-defined mass with multiple pleomorphic calcifications on mammography
key_facts: 2-year history of a growing breast nodule
nodule located in the lower outer quadrant of the left breast
lesion is firm, mobile, and well defined
no skin changes or nipple discharge
no palpable lymphadenopathy
mammography shows a well-defined mass with multiple pleomorphic calcifications
ultrasonography reveals a hypoechoic, subcutaneous, poorly circumscribed nodule
marked posterior acoustic shadowing from microcalcifications on ultrasonography
no locoregional lymphadenopathy on ultrasonography
lesion classified as ACR BI-RADS IV

shortlist.label: Breast Adenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: growing, painless breast nodule with calcifications and BI-RADS IV classification

shortlist.label: Phyllodes Tumor
shortlist.why_kept: firm, mobile, and well-defined nodule with increased size over time

shortlist.label: Fibroadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: well-defined mass with multiple pleomorphic calcifications on mammography

shortlist.label: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ
shortlist.why_kept: presence of microcalcifications and hypoechoic nodule on ultrasonography

shortlist.label: Papillary Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: poorly circumscribed nodule with marked posterior acoustic shadowing on ultrasonography

raw.rationale: The 2-year history of a growing, painless nodule with a well-defined mass and pleomorphic calcifications on mammography, along with ultrasonography showing a hypoechoic, subcutaneous, poorly circumscribed nodule with marked posterior acoustic shadowing, is more consistent with a Phyllodes Tumor, which can grow rapidly and have variable imaging appearances.

rejected.label: Breast Adenocarcinoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with more aggressive features such as skin changes, nipple discharge, or lymphadenopathy, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
rejected.why: Usually presents as a well-defined, mobile, and painless mass, but tends to be stable in size and less likely to have pleomorphic calcifications.

rejected.label: Ductal Carcinoma In Situ
rejected.why: Typically presents with microcalcifications on mammography, but is less likely to form a large, palpable mass like the one described in this case.

rejected.label: Papillary Carcinoma
rejected.why: Often presents with nipple discharge or a palpable mass, and is less likely to have the imaging characteristics described in this case.
